  JSON_EXTRACT(reportData, '$.comparables[0].rating') as r0,
  JSON_EXTRACT(reportData, '$.comparables[1].rating') as r1,
  JSON_EXTRACT(reportData, '$.comparables[2].rating') as r2,

  JSON_EXTRACT(reportData, '$.comparables[1].occupancy') as o1,
  JSON_EXTRACT(reportData, '$.comparables[0].adr') as a0,
  JSON_EXTRACT(reportData, '$.comparables[0].revenue') as rev0
FROM universal_shareable_reports
WHERE shareCode = '2v9cjmVa9k';
